name: recurpost
description: Schedule and publish social media posts through your RecurPost account.
long_description: Connects Claude to the whole RecurPost API: post or schedule content, manage queues, drafts, approvals, libraries and workspaces, review posting history and reports, and generate post copy or images with AI. The most used operations are direct tools; every other operation is reachable through list_operations, describe_operation and call_operation. Requires a RecurPost account and an API Password Key from Account Settings.

email.title: RecurPost email
email.description: The email address you log in to RecurPost with.

api_key.title: API Password Key
api_key.description: Generate one in RecurPost under Account Settings > API Password Key. This is not your login password.

api_url.title: API URL
api_url.description: Leave as is unless RecurPost support gives you another address.

modules.title: Extra direct tools
modules.description: Optional. Comma-separated API modules whose operations should all become direct tools (for example: inbox, feeds), or all for every operation. Everything stays reachable through call_operation either way.
